title: compass-ai-providers: custom providers + inline-JSON tool-call quirk
body:
## Summary

Extends `compass-ai-providers` with two gotchas learned in the Sep-22 UX/provider work: (1) custom providers — BYOK rows with name + base URL + model + optional key/JSON params, `/chat/completions` auto-appended, OpenAI-compatible path, persisted in state (PR #37); the AI Guidance UI now shows muted `recommended:` model hints instead of hard pins, so don't reintroduce hardcoded names. (2) Inline-JSON tool calls — Groq's `openai/gpt-oss-*` models emit `{"action","params"}`/`action_input` as raw reply text instead of tool_calls, which silently skipped memory saves until PR #41 added `parseInlineToolCalls`; if a provider answers but tools never fire, check for inline JSON before suspecting keys.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/a6531e43a3fe49b2a86830dcb12df294
